abstract: PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to determine the computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) characteristics of ovarian mature teratoma in patients with anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor encephalitis (NMDAR-E). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 125 women (mean age, 40.9±17.8 [SD] years; age range: 12-85 years) with 146 histopathologically or radiologically proven ovarian mature teratomas who underwent preoperative CT and MRI examinations were retrospectively included. Eight patients with 11 teratomas had NMDAR-E, whereas 117 patients with 135 teratomas did not have NMDAR-E. CT and MRI examinations were retrospectively reviewed and teratomas in patients with NMDAR-E were compared to those in patients without NMDAR-E. Comparisons were performed using Mann-Whitney U test or Fisher exact test. RESULTS: In patients with NMDAR-E, maximum diameter of teratomas (26.1±9.3 [SD] mm), prevalence of teeth/calcification (36%) and rate of occupation by fat components (26%) were lower than those in patients without NMDAR-E (67.0±37.6 [SD] mm [P<0.01]; 75% [P<0.05]; and 65%[P<0.01], respectively). More than 75% of space was occupied by fat components in 76/135 teratomas (56%) in patients without NMDAR-E, whereas this was not observed in any teratoma in patients without NMDAR-E. CONCLUSION: By comparison with teratomas in patients without NMDAR-E, teratomas in patients with NMDAR-E are smaller, have few teeth/calcification, and the amount of space occupied by fat components is smaller.
abstract_ja: 目的：本研究の目的は、抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体脳炎(NMDAR-E)患者における卵巣成熟奇形腫のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の特徴を明らかにすることであった。材料と方法：術前にCTおよびMRI検査を受け、病理組織学的または放射線学的に確定した卵巣成熟奇形腫146個を有する125人の女性(平均年齢40.9±17.8(SD)歳、年齢範囲12～85歳)を後方視的に登録した。NMDAR-Eを有する患者では11個の奇形腫、NMDAR-Eを有しない患者では135個の奇形腫が認められた。NMDAR-Eを有する患者では8名が該当した。CTおよびMRI検査を後方視的に評価し、NMDAR-Eを有する患者の奇形腫と、有しない患者の奇形腫を比較した。比較はマン・ホイットニーのU検定またはフィッシャーの正確確率検定を用いて行った。結果：NMDAR-Eを有する患者では、奇形腫の最大径(26.1±9.3(SD)mm)、歯牙/石灰化の有病率(36%)、および脂肪成分が占める割合(26%)は、NMDAR-Eを有しない患者(67.0±37.6(SD)mm[P<0.01]、75%[P<0.05]、65%[P<0.01])よりも低かった。NMDAR-Eを有しない患者の135個の奇形腫のうち76個(56%)では、脂肪成分が空間の75%以上を占めていたが、NMDAR-Eを有する患者の奇形腫ではこれは認められなかった。結論：NMDAR-Eを有しない患者の奇形腫と比較して、NMDAR-Eを有する患者の奇形腫は小さく、歯牙や石灰化が少なく、脂肪成分が占める空間の割合も小さい。
